channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: The unseen hands behind Mysuru Dasara’s dazzling lights
item.description: 642 CESC personnel work behind the scenes to keep the city aglow

item.title: Bombe Mane returns with tales of tradition
item.description: A house located at 2nd Cross in Ramachandra Agrahara, known for its Bombe Mane for the past three decades, has once again opened its doors to a magnificent collection of dolls with distinctive artistic designs

item.title: Srirangapatna Dasara begins on a grand note
item.description: Actor-director V. Ravichandran inaugurates festivities; 62 cultural troupes and 10 tableaux take part in procession

item.title: Trial run of Kambala passes off smoothly in Mysuru
item.description: 150 pairs of buffaloes had been selected to participate in the two-day event scheduled for October 18 and 19

item.title: Fusion, devotion and star power strike a chord at Mysuru Dasara
item.description: Music and dance programmes add vibrancy to festivities as crowds throng venues

item.title: Call to make Mysuru Dasara ‘Tobacco-free’
Colours of life: How this eight hearing-impaired women stitched a new future through skill training in Malappuram
item.description: Sabna V.K., Ramya A., Afeefa K., Sameena M.K., Nimmy N., Rajeena P., Salma V.P., and Sajeena C. began ‘Colours’ after completing a assistant dress maker course under Jan Shikshan Sansthan

item.title: Heavy rain snarls traffic, ride-hailing fares surge in Bengaluru
item.description: Slow-moving traffic due to waterlogging was also reported on M.G. Road, Commissionerate Road, Acharya Layout Road, Anand Rao Circle, R.P. Road towards P.G. Halli, Mehkri Circle, and Jayamahal, among other locations

item.title: Eating out in Mumbai to get costlier as restaurants plan 10–15% menu price hike
item.description: AHAR cites rising cooking gas prices, food costs, rentals and wages; revised rates likely to be introduced in the coming weeks

item.title: Bihar Vigilance raids Rural Works Department engineer in disproportionate assets case
item.description: Vigilance tightens noose around engineer accused of amassing disproportionate assets, conducted simultaneous raids at engineer’s four locations at Chhapra, Patna, Katihar & Darjeeling.

item.title: CJP Tiranga rally: Movement around Connaught place likely to be affected, says Delhi Traffic police
item.description: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) on Thursday (October 15, 2026) announced that Central Park in Connaught Place would remain closed to the public on October 16 and 17 for “administrative reasons”

item.title: Naidu, Chouhan highlight role of SHGs in promoting women empowerment
item.description: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan says 3.5 crore women, of the targeted 6 crore, have achieved the target of ₹1 lakh annual income, with A.P. accounting for 23 lakh of them; State govt. will provide permanent spaces for SARAS Mela in the city, says Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu

item.title: Jagan speaks up for CJP leaders in judicial custody, draws BJP fire in Andhra
item.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke thanks the former Chief Minister; BJP leader Satya Kumar Yadav asks why the electoral process was fine when the YSRCP won 151 seats in 2019

item.title: From the looms of Assam to the President’s wardrobe, Eri silk makes a mark
item.description: Droupadi Murmu purchases naturally dyed indigo blue Eri shawl featuring elaborate motifs for ₹4,500 and makes the payment via UPI at the SARAS Mela in Vijayawada

item.title: Over six lakh voters eligible to vote in Guntur civic polls on October 28
item.description: Nominations will be received from October 16 to 18 and votes counted on October 30

item.title: ULB polls: NDA arrives at seat-sharing pact
item.description: The TDP will contest 11 of the 17 Municipal Corporations, including the Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation, while the JSP and BJP will be in the fray in four and two corporations respectively

item.title: Rural women deserve hand-holding for a brighter future, says Andhra Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan
item.description: We need to salute their courage, resilience and enterprising nature, which are strengthening farms, sustaining families and driving villages forward, he says on the occasion of International Day of Rural Women

item.title: Call for curbing inter-State drug smuggling
item.description: DGP Harish Kumar Gupta flags off motor cycle rally titled ‘Fight Against Drugs’ to Gujarat

item.title: File affidavit over infants’ death at RIMS: HC to government
Conversion does not automatically grant quota benefits: Supreme Court
item.description: Court clarifies law while dismissing a Tamil Nadu government appeal seeking confirmation of the State’s policy to provide reservation benefits to members of Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, Denotified Communities and Scheduled Castes who embrace Islam

item.title: INDIA bloc leaders in Tamil Nadu stage protest against SIR, seek CEC’s resignation
item.description: They allege the exercise threatens democratic rights, and call for the agitation to be extended across Tamil Nadu

item.title: TNSTC bus crew suspended after anti-DMK messages appear on govt. vehicle’s digital display board in Tamil Nadu
item.description: According to official sources, the route board of the bus carried several anti-DMK slogans, as well as jibes against party leaders

item.title: What 107 innings reveal about the Smriti-Shafali opening pair | Data
item.description: In their last 15 innings, Shafali’s strike rate exceeded 170 and Mandhana’s 150, career highs over any 15-innings stretch

item.title: BJP criticises TVK for taking part in INDIA bloc’s protest against SIR
Uttarakhand Minister accuses husband of fraudulent marriage, assault and life threats
item.description: Rekha Arya has lodged a First Information Report against her husband Girdhari Lal Sahu, accusing him of concealing his previous marriage and extramarital affair

item.title: Telangana invites Tamil Nadu businesses to join its growth journey
Southern Latitudes: Scenes from Madras & Trivandrum exhibition in Thiruvananthapuram traces the birth of modernism in south India
item.description: Curated by Tensing Joseph, the exhibition showcases the emergence of modernism in Keralam and south India through more than 140 works by 30 artists, with paintings from pivotal figures such as KCS Paniker, CL Porinchukutty and Kanayi Kunhiraman, among others

item.title: Unemployment rate in country stands at 5% in September, stable compared to August: NSO
item.description: The rural unemployment rate remains “broadly stable” at 4.2% against 4.1% in August, while urban rate marginally rises from 6.8% in August to 6.9% in this month

item.title: The debate over immunity to CEC, ECs
item.description: The SC has issued a notice to the Centre on a plea challenging Section 16 of the 2023 law, which grants CEC and ECs lifelong immunity for actions taken in discharge of official duties; the provision is more expansive than constitutional immunities provided to the President and Governors; as well as Parliamentary privileges granted to legislators

item.title: Odisha to continue with ballot papers for rural polls, EVMs for urban
item.description: A house-to-house survey for the preparation of electoral rolls for the upcoming Panchayat and Municipal Elections–2027 will begin on October 26

item.title: Meterless autos leave passengers at drivers’ mercy in Kozhikode
item.description: Drivers allegedly disconnect fare meters and demand arbitrary fares from passengers; night surcharge reportedly levied after 9 p.m., though rules permit it only from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m.

item.title: Atiq Ahmed’s former stronghold renamed Shrikrishnapuri, 1,200 poor families to get houses: Adityanath
item.description: Issuing a stern warning to criminals, Yogi Adityanath said no one would dare to indulge in mafia activities in Prayagraj, and those who did, would have to be prepared to be "reduced to dust"

item.title: Makeover matters least in Nedumbassery car-hit case, say legal experts
item.description: Criminal law experts say CCTV visuals, forensic evidence and witness statements would play a crucial role in deciding the fate of the case, as the identity of the accused is already widely known

item.title: KIIFB has plunged Keralam into severe financial crisis, says Keralam Chief Minister VD. Satheesan
item.description: After tabling the report of the expert committee headed by former Planning Commission Member-Secretary Sudha Pillai in the Assembly, he says government will examine the report and consider ordering an investigation, adding that the transactions of the KIIFB, which the previous LDF government used as a special purpose vehicle to finance major infrastructure projects, had resulted in “huge losses” for the government

item.title: Cheruvayal Raman laid to rest with State honours
item.description: The 74-year-old farmer, fondly known as ‘Nellachan’, passed away on Wednesday around 3.30 p.m. while undergoing treatment for a heart-related ailment at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir High Court bars use of shikara motorboats, jet skis on Dal lake in Srinagar
item.description: The court exempted the boats used by the administration and the authorities for the purpose of emergency services, law and order and disaster management.

item.title: Northeast monsoon sets in over Keralam; yellow alert for State on Oct. 16
item.description: Ahead of the arrival of the northeast monsoon, maximum temperature fell appreciably in Kollam and Thiruvananthapuram districts

item.title: Akkulam earth cave-in: apartment residents relocated
item.description: The Collector had ordered suspension of building construction in a private school compound after earth removal by school led to collapse of a stretch of road in front of the flats

item.title: Kerala Assembly unanimously passes resolution asking Union government to accept State’s revised ESA proposal
item.description: State government’s revised Ecologically Sensitive Area proposal covers an area of 8,590.69 sq km in 98 revenue villages. Centre urged to issue final notification on ESA in the Western Ghats only after considering the proposal submitted by the State govt. so as to safeguard the interests of the people of the State

item.title: Keralam Assembly passes resolution asking Union govt. to withdraw MDR charges on UPI transactions
item.description: Ruling UDF supports the resolution passed by CPI MLA K. Rajan, while two BJP MLAs oppose it

item.title: Apartment residents stage protest alleging denial of amenities by builder
Keralam Assembly passes motion against Palakkad railway division bifurcation
item.description: The motion was adopted amid opposition from the Bharatiya Janata Party MLAs in the House

item.title: Case against Keralam MLA Najeeb Kanthapuram for blocking court-ordered attachment
item.description: Case filed after complaint by an advocate commissioner. Four unidentified persons too named as accused

item.title: Work on international terminal expansion begins at Thiruvananthapuram airport
Keralam’s move to reconstitute Waqf Board challenged in High Court
item.description: Affidavit filed by Board members says that the vacancy of two members is not sufficient reason to invalidate the Board

item.title: Stalled cricket stadium project at SSUS likely to be revived
item.description: The project was put on hold due to concerns about clarity of financial gains for the varsity and the long-term transfer of the six-acre land to a private entity

item.title: Half of all road accident fatalities occur on NH: Keralam Minister
‘Poshakamrutham’ scheme launched in Ernakulam
item.description: The project aims to identify children up to 12 years of age who are suffering from malnutrition in Scheduled Tribe areas in the district through medical examinations and provide them with vitamin supplements and food kits

item.title: Man held on charge of cheating women through matrimonial sites
item.description: He was arrested following a complaint by a schoolteacher from Kodiyathur, who alleged that he cheated her of ₹4.85 lakh

item.title: Health experts warn of spike in infectious diseases as northeast monsoon arrives in Keralam
item.description: Rise in vector and water-borne diseases due to intermittent rain remains a major health concern; local bodies told to strengthen implementation of Arogyabheri, a year-long epidemic prevention action plan that focusses on disease prevention

item.title: More deadlines missed in Chander Kunj rebuild as AWHO opposes takeover of apartments
item.description: AWHO ignored the Collector’s notice to begin the takeover on October 12 and filed a writ petition before the Kerala High Court challenging the Collector’s order

item.title: Kerala Folklore Academy announces plans to promote traditional art forms
item.description: Academy to hold consultations with experts on the possibility of establishing a folklore university in the State

item.title: SC/ST JRF scholars write to Bangalore University V-C, urge review of fee notification
University of Liverpool opens campus in Bengaluru; 300 students enrolled
Karnataka: State-wide food safety drive targets sweet outlets ahead of festive season
item.description: 125 samples collected, notices issued to 10 units

item.title: Bengalurean to head NASA’s $20 million space telescope mission
item.description: PUFFINS mission will study the smallest grains of dust between the stars: particles roughly the size of a common cold virus

item.title: Karnataka Cabinet rejects mercy petitions of Shubha and Arun in Ring Road murder case
item.description: The case, dating back to 2003, involved the murder of 27-year-old software engineer B.V. Girish. The conspiracy was hatched by Shubha, to whom he was engaged to marry

item.title: Congress questions MEA’s silence on proposed Rubio-Jaishankar meeting
item.description: The Opposition party’s dig at the government follows remarks by U.S. Ambassador to India Sergio Gor during an interactive session at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum

item.title: PAC grills Centre, States on ‘fraud markers’ flagged by CAG in SC scholarship schemes
item.description: Committee Members question the Secretary, Social Justice and Empowerment Ministry, on why action-taken reports against points highlighted in the CAG audit had not been submitted; Ministry assures panel that the reports will be submitted in a month’s time

item.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh to represent India at upcoming SCO Heads of Government meeting
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be taking part virtually through video-conference; the two-day meeting will bring together heads of government and designated senior representatives of SCO member states to discuss regional cooperation and economic engagement
